title: feat(nm2frm2l3): L-path cyclic-frame transport -e3 then +e2 at t+1 on three-axis opposite near-face seed: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Bare L-path (-e3,+e2) on the three-axis near-face seed. Shows the +e2 turn is insensitive to the third seed pair (same pair as on the two-axis seed), in contrast to the +e1 turn which the same third pair kills - the interference is direction-selective, not a global seed effect.
